note: Invented lines for the stub stand-in of the M.E.R.C. owner, compiled by pnpm stubs into npcdata/159.edt (240 units per quote id of Speck_Quotes.h). Lines not listed use the filler. Original writing for ja2-node.
filler: Every merc on my list is a bargain. Line {quote}.

lines.0: Welcome to the stub mercenary exchange, friend. Pull up a chair.
lines.1: We keep the books simple: you hire, we bill, everybody smiles.
lines.2: No contracts to sign. You pay for the days you use.
lines.3: Open an account and the files are yours to browse.
lines.4: My people are cheaper than the big agency and twice as hungry.
lines.5: Settle up now and then and we stay friends.
lines.6: Miss too many payments and the account goes cold.
lines.7: Take your time. The coffee here is terrible but it is free.
lines.8: That is the whole pitch. Go on, have a look around.
lines.9: Account open! Thank you kindly. The files are unlocked.
lines.10: Back again? Tough start out there, I bet.
lines.11: Business is slow. Hire somebody and make my day.
lines.13: I am still recruiting. New faces soon.
lines.14: Your account is suspended until you settle the bill.
lines.15: You owe me a small fortune.
lines.16: Pay up before my accountant notices.
lines.20: Good to see you. What can I do for you today?
lines.21: Have a look at the files.
lines.45: Paid in full. A pleasure doing business.
lines.46: Part of it is better than nothing. Thanks.
lines.69: Great choice. You will not regret that hire.
lines.70: Thank you for hiring through the exchange.
lines.71: That one is already working for you, friend.
